proposed.en: A large entrance or reception area in a hotel, theatre or similar building.
proposed.ko: 호텔이나 극장 등의 넓은 입구나 접견 공간.

reason: Use British theatre rather than theater and replace awkward room description.

original.en: In a hotel or theater, etc., a wide space used both as a reception room and as a passage.
original.ko: 호텔이나 극장 등에서, 응접실이나 통로를 겸한 넓은 공간.

proposed.en: An inorganic substance, such as calcium or sodium, needed by the body.
proposed.ko: 칼슘이나 나트륨처럼 몸에 필요한 무기질.

reason: Natrium is not the usual English name for sodium; definition also repeats mineral.

original.en: A mineral substance such as calcium and natrium, which is necessary for the nutrition of life forms.
original.ko: 칼슘이나 나트륨과 같이 생물이 살아가는 데 필요한 광물성의 물질.

proposed.en: The process of planning or following a route to a destination.
proposed.ko: 목적지까지의 경로를 정하거나 따라가는 과정.

reason: Navigation names a process, not specifically a satnav device.

original.en: A device or program that shows the route to a destination, such as a car.
original.ko: 자동차 등이 목적지로 가는 길을 알려 주는 장치나 프로그램.

proposed.en: A grammatical voice in which the subject receives the action.
proposed.ko: 주어가 동작의 대상이 되는 문법적 태인 수동태.

reason: The original incorrectly says the agent receives the action; it is the grammatical subject.

original.en: In language, the quality of a verb used to indicate that the agent is acted upon by an external force or object.
original.ko: 언어에서, 주체가 남 또는 다른 것의 힘에 의하여 움직이는 동사의 성질.

proposed.en: A small solid dose of medicine intended to be swallowed.
proposed.ko: 삼켜 먹도록 만든 작은 고형 약.

reason: A pill is swallowed, not applied to skin or injected.

original.en: A substance orally administered, applied or injected to treat or prevent an illness, wound, etc.
original.ko: 병이나 상처 등을 낫게 하거나 예방하기 위하여 먹거나 바르거나 주사하는 물질.

proposed.en: Something added to complete or improve something else.
proposed.ko: 부족한 부분을 채우거나 개선하기 위해 더하는 것.

reason: The noun supplement denotes the added thing rather than only the act of adding.

original.en: The act of filling up a deficiency.
original.ko: 부족한 것을 보태어 채움.

proposed.en: To add something extra to complete or improve something.
proposed.ko: 보완하거나 개선하기 위해 무언가를 더하다.

reason: Supplement means add, not substitute.

original.en: To supplement or substitute something with another thing.
original.ko: 다른 방법으로 어떤 일을 보충하거나 대신하다.

proposed.en: The main woody stem of a tree.
proposed.ko: 나무의 중심이 되는 굵은 줄기.

reason: A trunk is the main tree stem, not any plant stem.

original.en: The part of a plant that serves as a support for the plant, carries water or nutrients absorbed by the root and has leaves, branches, fruits, etc., on it.
original.ko: 식물을 받치고 뿌리에서 빨아들인 수분이나 양분을 나르며, 잎이나 가지, 열매 등이 붙는 부분.

proposed.en: A state of not knowing what is true or what will happen.
proposed.ko: 무엇이 사실인지 또는 무슨 일이 일어날지 확실히 알 수 없는 상태.

reason: Uncertainty concerns lack of certainty, not dizziness.

original.en: Feeling dizzy because the atmosphere or situation is not stable.
original.ko: 분위기나 상황이 안정되지 않아 어지러움.

proposed.en: To neglect a responsibility or duty.
proposed.ko: 책임이나 의무를 저버리다.

reason: This source sense is the verb abandon; the noun abandon means uninhibited freedom.

original.en: The act of ignoring one's responsibility, duty, etc., and not paying attention to or caring about it.
original.ko: 책임이나 의무 등을 무시하여 관심을 갖거나 돌보지 않음.

proposed.en: To provide someone with a place to stay.
proposed.ko: 머무를 장소를 제공하다.

reason: Accommodate provides lodging rather than forcing a person to stay.

original.en: To make a person stay.
original.ko: 사람을 머무르게 하다.

proposed.en: To secure a boat with an anchor or fix something firmly in place.
proposed.ko: 닻으로 배를 고정하거나 어떤 것을 제자리에 단단히 고정하다.

reason: Merely stopping during a journey is insufficient: anchoring involves securing something.

original.en: To stop in one's way or to stay at a place temporarily.
original.ko: 도중에 멈추거나 일시적으로 어떤 곳에 묵다.

proposed.en: A small object worn on clothes to show identity, membership or support for a cause.
proposed.ko: 신분, 소속이나 지지를 나타내려고 옷에 다는 작은 표지.

reason: Clothing is uncountable, so a clothing is ungrammatical.

original.en: A small object to attach to a clothing, hat, etc., in order to show one's identity, affiliation or opinion.
original.ko: 신분이나 소속을 알리거나 어떤 뜻을 나타내기 위하여 웃옷이나 모자 등에 붙이는 작은 물건.

proposed.en: A large gun that fires heavy shells using an explosive charge.
proposed.ko: 폭약의 힘으로 무거운 포탄을 쏘는 큰 화포.

reason: The original uses a explosive rather than an explosive.

original.en: A weapon that fires a shell to a distant place, powered by a explosive powder.
original.ko: 화약의 힘으로 포탄을 멀리 쏘는 무기.

proposed.en: The state of having many interconnected parts or being difficult to understand.
proposed.ko: 서로 연결된 부분이 많거나 이해하기 어려운 복잡성.

reason: Complexity need not involve disorder.

original.en: A disorder due to being mixed up in a complicated way.
original.ko: 복잡하게 뒤섞여 어수선함.

proposed.en: Intentionally or after careful thought.
proposed.ko: 의도적으로 또는 신중히 생각한 뒤에.

reason: Deliberately expresses intention, not concealment of intention.

original.en: With one's real purpose or intention hidden.
original.ko: 알면서도 아는 것을 숨기거나 어떤 행위를 하는 본래 마음을 숨기고.

proposed.en: A calm, serious manner that deserves respect.
proposed.ko: 존중받을 만한 차분하고 진지한 태도나 품위.

reason: The existing definition repeats dignity without explaining it.

original.en: One's dignity when dealing with others.
original.ko: 남을 대할 체면.

proposed.en: An independent direction or coordinate needed to describe a space.
proposed.ko: 공간을 나타내는 데 필요한 독립적인 방향이나 좌표의 수와 관련된 차원.

reason: Mathematical dimension is not simply an area or spatial width.

original.en: In mathematics, a measure of spatial extent.
original.ko: 수학에서, 공간적인 넓이를 나타내는 수.

proposed.en: Failing to meet expectations and causing dissatisfaction.
proposed.ko: 기대에 못 미쳐 실망을 주는.

reason: Disappointing causes disappointment; the original describes feeling disappointed.

original.en: Losing hope or feeling somewhat hurt because something did not work out.
original.ko: 기대하던 대로 되지 않아 희망을 잃거나 마음이 몹시 상한 데가 있다.

proposed.en: To remove a substance from inside something.
proposed.ko: 어떤 것의 내부에서 물질을 뽑아내다.

reason: English omits the gas mentioned in Korean; a substance covers both.

original.en: To make liquid inside something come outside.
original.ko: 속에 있는 기체나 액체를 밖으로 나오게 하다.

proposed.en: The ability to bend or change shape without breaking.
proposed.ko: 부러지지 않고 휘거나 형태가 바뀔 수 있는 성질.

reason: Expansion and contraction describe elasticity more specifically than flexibility.

original.en: The quality of an object expanding and contracting.
original.ko: 물체가 늘어나고 줄어드는 성질.

reason: Romanised Korean 굿 ritual was imported as English gut; quarantine rather than replace with an unrelated intestinal sense.

original.en: A ritual in which a shaman prepares food, sings, dances, and prays to the spirits to grant good luck or to expel bad luck.
original.ko: 무당이 음식을 차려 놓고 노래를 하고 춤을 추며 귀신에게 복을 빌거나 나쁜 것을 물리쳐 달라고 비는 의식.

proposed.en: A very large, impressive house.
proposed.ko: 매우 크고 으리으리한 저택.

reason: Mansion in English is a large house, not the Korean loanword for an upmarket flat.

original.en: A large premium apartment.
original.ko: 면적이 넓은 고급 아파트.

proposed.en: A silver-white metal valued for its resistance to corrosion and used in jewellery and industry.
proposed.ko: 부식에 강하여 보석 장신구와 산업에 쓰는 은백색 금속인 백금.

reason: Use British jewellery rather than jewelry.

original.en: A silver-white metallic element that is harder than silver and is used for making jewelry, machines, etc., as it does not rust.
original.ko: 은보다 단단하며 녹슬지 않아 장식품이나 기계 등에 쓰는, 은백색의 금속.

proposed.en: The likelihood that an event will happen, often expressed as a number.
proposed.ko: 어떤 일이 일어날 가능성으로, 흔히 수치로 나타내는 확률.

reason: Calcuating is misspelt; definition can state likelihood directly.

original.en: The degree of possibility that a certain event will take place under a certain condition; or the number obtained by calcuating such a degree.
original.ko: 일정한 조건 아래에서 어떤 일이 일어날 수 있는 가능성의 정도. 또는 그 정도를 계산한 수치.

proposed.en: A player selected to take part from the beginning of a match.
proposed.ko: 경기 시작부터 출전하도록 선정된 선수.

reason: A starter is the player, not the act of starting the match.

original.en: In a baseball or soccer, etc., the act of participating in the game from the beginning; or such a player.
original.ko: 야구나 축구 등에서, 경기 시작부터 출전하는 일. 또는 그런 선수.

proposed.en: The act of attaching something to a surface.
proposed.ko: 물건을 표면에 붙이거나 다는 행위.

reason: Korean 닮 is a typo for 달다 in this source context.

original.en: The act of sticking or attaching something to a surface so that it will not become detached.
original.ko: 떨어지지 않게 붙이거나 닮.

reason: Source describes making a contract offer; this does not establish an English subscribe sense and needs source realignment.

original.en: To make a unilateral, definite statement that promises the settlement of a contract.
original.ko: 일정한 내용의 계약을 이루는 것을 목적으로 하는 일방적이고 확정적인 의사 표시를 하다.

reason: Use the British English headword spelling; preserve the US spelling as an alias.

original.en: A rubber frame that is put around the outer rim of a wheel of a car or bicycle.
original.ko: 자동차나 자전거 바퀴의 바깥 둘레에 끼우는 고무로 만든 테.

proposed.en: The difference in electric potential between two points.
proposed.ko: 두 지점 사이의 전위차.

reason: Voltage is electric potential difference, not energy difference alone.

original.en: Difference in electric energy between two points in an electric field or conductor.
original.ko: 전기장이나 도체 내에 있는 두 점 사이의 전기 에너지의 차.

proposed.en: The distance from one side of something to the other.
proposed.ko: 어떤 것의 한쪽 끝에서 반대쪽 끝까지의 너비.

reason: Width is a linear measurement, not area or general extent.

original.en: The extent of a space or surface that a place or object occupies.
original.ko: 어떤 장소나 물건이 차지하는 공간이나 평면의 넓은 정도.

proposed.en: For a horse to jump and kick its hind legs up.
proposed.ko: 말이 뛰면서 뒷다리를 위로 차올리다.

reason: Buck describes the characteristic kicking jump, not any high jump.

original.en: To jump as if flying.
original.ko: 날듯이 껑충껑충 뛰다.

reason: Use the British English headword spelling; preserve the US spelling as an alias.

original.en: An advanced state of material, technological and social life for humans.
original.ko: 사람의 물질적, 기술적, 사회적 생활이 발전한 상태.

proposed.en: Fine, fragile or easily damaged.
proposed.ko: 가늘고 섬세하거나 쉽게 손상되는.

reason: Length and smoothness are not necessary features of delicate.

original.en: Sleek, thin, and long.
original.ko: 매끈하고 가늘며 길다.

proposed.en: A flat circular object used to store information, such as a magnetic disk or an optical disc.
proposed.ko: 정보를 저장하는 데 쓰는 납작한 원형 매체.

reason: A cassette tape is not a disk; retain the computing spelling disk.

original.en: A CD, cassette tape, or record disk in which many songs are stored.
original.ko: 음악이 여러 곡 담겨 있는 시디나 카세트테이프, 레코드판.

proposed.en: A strong alcoholic drink, especially a distilled spirit.
proposed.ko: 특히 증류주와 같은 도수가 높은 술.

reason: Beer is not normally liquor in this everyday sense.

original.en: A beverage that contains alcoholic ingredients so that one gets drunk if one drinks it, such as beer, soju, Korean distilled liquor, etc.
original.ko: 맥주나 소주 등과 같이 알코올 성분이 들어 있어서 마시면 취하는 음료.

proposed.en: A son of one’s brother or sister, or of one’s spouse’s sibling.
proposed.ko: 자신이나 배우자의 형제자매의 아들인 남자 조카.

reason: Nephew is male; the original says any child.

original.en: A child of one's sibling.
original.ko: 형제자매가 낳은 자식.

proposed.en: Wood prepared for use in building or carpentry.
proposed.ko: 건축이나 목공에 쓰려고 마련한 목재.

reason: The original defines firewood, not timber.

original.en: The trunk or branches of a tree cut to be used as firewood.
original.ko: 불을 때기 위해 베어 놓은 나무의 줄기나 가지.

proposed.en: A person who comes to see someone or a place.
proposed.ko: 사람이나 장소를 찾아오는 방문객.

reason: Visitor has no inherent honorific register in English.

original.en: (honorific) A person who comes to visit someone.
original.ko: (높임말로) 다른 곳에서 찾아온 사람.

proposed.en: An organic nutrient needed in small amounts for normal bodily functions.
proposed.ko: 몸의 정상적인 기능에 소량 필요한 유기 영양소.

reason: Not all vitamins are wholly unproduced by the body; vitamin D is an obvious counterexample.

original.en: A nutrient essential for animals' growth although it is not produced inside the body.
original.ko: 몸 안에서 만들어지지는 않지만 동물의 성장에 꼭 필요한 영양소.

proposed.en: A flexible strip or cord attached to a handle, used for striking.
proposed.ko: 손잡이에 유연한 끈이나 띠가 달린 채찍.

reason: A whip is not simply any rigid stick or the act of beating.

original.en: A stick with which to beat a person or animal, or the act of beating with such a stick.
original.ko: 사람이나 짐승을 때리는 막대기. 또는 그것으로 때리는 일.

proposed.en: To beat a liquid or mixture rapidly to make it light or smooth.
proposed.ko: 액체나 혼합물을 빠르게 저어 가볍거나 매끄럽게 만들다.

reason: Throughly is misspelt and whipping is beating rather than merely stirring side to side.

original.en: To stir something from side to side wildly to mix it throughly.
original.ko: 골고루 섞이도록 이리저리 마구 젓다.

proposed.en: To remove something from a surface by rubbing it with a cloth or hand.
proposed.ko: 천이나 손으로 문질러 표면에 묻은 것을 제거하다.

reason: The English definition repeats wipe rather than explaining the action.

original.en: To wipe away something that clings to the surface.
original.ko: 겉에 묻은 것을 없어지게 닦아내다.

proposed.en: A high-ranking naval officer.
proposed.ko: 해군의 고위 장교인 제독.

reason: An admiral specifically serves in the navy, not any armed force.

original.en: A high-ranking person in the military that leads and commands his/her troops.
original.ko: 군대에서 최고의 지위를 가지고 군대를 거느리고 지휘하는 사람.

reason: Romanised Korean 보 wrapping cloth is not an established general English bo headword; quarantine for lexical verification.

original.en: wrapping cloth: A square-shaped cloth used for wrapping or covering something.
original.ko: 물건을 싸거나 씌우기 위하여 만든 네모난 천.

proposed.en: The activity of staying outdoors in a tent or temporary shelter.
proposed.ko: 텐트나 임시 숙소에서 야외 생활을 하는 활동.

reason: Camping denotes the activity, not specifically the site or a military camp.

original.en: A place in a certain area, equipped with necessary facilities for an army to stay temporarily; or the life of living at such a place.
original.ko: 군대가 어떤 지역에서 임시로 지내며 필요한 시설을 갖추어 놓은 곳. 또는 거기서 하는 생활.

proposed.en: A sudden seizure of governmental power, usually by a small group using force.
proposed.ko: 보통 소수 집단이 무력으로 정부 권력을 갑자기 장악하는 일.

reason: A coup need not overthrow a dynasty.

original.en: A state in which a new force overthrows a current dynasty and takes control of the country.
original.ko: 이전의 왕조를 물리치고 새로운 세력이 통치권을 잡는 일.

proposed.en: Roughly made or lacking refinement.
proposed.ko: 거칠게 만들었거나 세련되지 못한.

reason: Crude does not necessarily mean sturdy.

original.en: The appearance of someone or something being just dull and sturdy.
original.ko: 생긴 모양이 볼품없이 둔하고 튼튼하기만 하다.

proposed.en: A sudden, quick movement or short run.
proposed.ko: 갑작스럽고 빠른 움직임이나 짧은 달리기.

reason: A dash is not restricted to attacking an opponent in sport.

original.en: A fierce, fast, deep attack at the opponent in a sports game.
original.ko: 운동 경기에서 상대 선수나 상대편을 거세고 빠르게 깊숙이 공격함.

proposed.en: Having a characteristic that makes it easy to recognise or distinguish.
proposed.ko: 쉽게 알아보거나 구별하게 하는 특징이 있는.

reason: Distinctive means recognisably characteristic, not merely different.

original.en: There being a difference.
original.ko: 보통 것과 크게 다르다.

proposed.en: A person or group accompanying someone for protection or guidance.
proposed.ko: 보호하거나 안내하려고 누군가와 동행하는 사람이나 집단.

reason: The noun entry currently uses a verb infinitive rather than naming an escort.

original.en: To follow an individual or group and provide comfortable protection or guidance.
original.ko: 개인이나 단체를 따라다니며 편안하게 보호하거나 안내함.

proposed.en: To give someone an idea, enthusiasm or motivation.
proposed.ko: 다른 사람에게 생각, 열정이나 의욕을 불어넣다.

reason: Inspire causes an idea or motivation in another person, rather than simply coming to understand.

original.en: To come to think of or understand a certain thing.
original.ko: 어떤 것에 대해 생각이나 이해가 되다.

proposed.en: To move or pull something suddenly and sharply.
proposed.ko: 갑자기 홱 움직이거나 잡아당기다.

reason: The original omits the sudden, sharp movement that distinguishes jerk.

original.en: To grab and pull someone or something towards oneself.
original.ko: 손으로 잡고 자기 쪽으로 끌다.

proposed.en: Used in a formal or sometimes impatient request to mean please.
proposed.ko: 격식 있거나 때로는 재촉하는 요청에서 정중히 부탁할 때 쓰는 말.

reason: Kindly in requests is please, not a statement of eager hope.

original.en: I hope eagerly; if possible.
original.ko: 간절하게 바라건대. 또는 될 수 있는 대로.

proposed.en: The size, extent or importance of something.
proposed.ko: 어떤 것의 크기, 규모 또는 중요성.

reason: Magnitude does not imply desperation or depth.

original.en: The nature of something being very deep, important, and desperate.
original.ko: 매우 깊고 중대하며 절박한 성질.

proposed.en: A minus sign, a negative quantity or a disadvantage.
proposed.ko: 마이너스 기호, 음수 또는 불리한 점.

reason: Subtraction itself is subtraction; the noun minus needs its sign, quantity or disadvantage sense.

original.en: An act of subtracting one number from another.

original.ko: 바로 향해 보다.

proposed.ko: 공이나 물건을 가볍게 위로 던지는 동작.

reason: English says basketball while Korean says volleyball; the general throw sense avoids an incorrect sport restriction.

original.en: In basketball, an act of throwing the ball slightly upwards.
original.ko: 배구에서, 공을 위로 가볍게 띄우는 것.

proposed.en: The consequences or period following a damaging event.
proposed.ko: 해로운 사건 뒤에 남는 결과나 그 이후의 시기.

reason: Aftermath is not a physical mark or scar on a body.

original.en: A spot on a human body or an object where a mark is left after it underwent a change.
original.ko: 사람의 몸이나 물건 등이 변화를 겪고 난 후 흔적이 남은 곳.

proposed.en: Direct in speech, sometimes to the point of seeming rude.
proposed.ko: 말이 직설적이어서 때로는 무례하게 느껴지는.

original.en: A person's manner of speaking, behavior, facial expression, etc., being not soft or congenial, so as to give an impression of coldness.
original.ko: 말, 행동, 표정 등이 부드럽거나 상냥하지 않아 정이 느껴지지 않다.

proposed.en: A senior Roman Catholic church official who may help elect a pope.
proposed.ko: 교황 선출 등에 참여할 수 있는 로마 가톨릭의 고위 성직자.

reason: The noun denotes the church official, not the abstract office; cardinal does not require the simple priest hierarchy described.

original.en: In Catholicism, the highest priest next to the Pope.
original.ko: 가톨릭교에서, 교황 다음으로 높은 성직.

proposed.en: Sparkling wine produced in the Champagne region of France.
proposed.ko: 프랑스 샹파뉴 지역에서 생산한 스파클링 와인.

reason: Champagne can be rosé and is not colourless.

original.en: A refreshing light-coloured wine with carbon dioxide bubbles, made in Champagne, France.
original.ko: 프랑스의 샹파뉴 지방에서 만드는, 탄산가스가 들어 있고 상쾌한 맛이 나며 색깔이 없는 포도주.

proposed.en: Works of literature or art recognised as having lasting value.
proposed.ko: 오랫동안 가치를 인정받는 문학이나 예술 작품들.

reason: Classics is plural, whereas both source definitions describe one work.

original.en: A work of art or literature widely recognised for its value for a long time in a certain field.
original.ko: 어떤 분야에서 오랫동안 가치가 높다고 널리 인정된 문학이나 예술 작품.

proposed.en: The organisation of people or activities so that they work together effectively.
proposed.ko: 사람이나 활동이 효과적으로 함께 이루어지도록 조정하는 일.

reason: Use British harmonise if retaining original; revised definition is more precise.

original.en: An act of joining forces to harmonize with one another.
original.ko: 힘을 합쳐 서로 조화를 이룸.

proposed.en: A long, narrow channel dug in the ground, often to carry water.
proposed.ko: 흔히 물을 흘려보내려고 땅에 판 길고 좁은 도랑.

reason: A ditch is a dug channel, not any natural brook.

original.en: A small narrow brook.
original.ko: 폭이 좁고 작은 개울.

proposed.en: An informal, insulting word for a foolish person.
proposed.ko: 어리석은 사람을 낮잡아 부르는 비격식 표현.

reason: The source omits the insulting informal register.

original.en: A person with bizarre and foolish behavior or a way of thinking.
original.ko: 행동이나 사고방식이 엉뚱하고 바보 같은 사람.

proposed.en: A cloud of tiny water droplets near the ground that reduces visibility.
proposed.ko: 땅 가까이에 작은 물방울이 떠 있어 시야를 흐리게 하는 안개.

reason: Use vapour rather than vapor if retaining source wording; definition clarifies visibility.

original.en: The phenomenon where water vapor comes together to form tiny, misty droplets that float close to the ground.
original.ko: 땅 가까이에서 수증기가 뭉쳐 아주 작은 물방울들이 부옇게 떠 있는 현상.

proposed.en: To communicate by moving part of the body, especially the hands.
proposed.ko: 특히 손 등 몸의 일부를 움직여 뜻을 전하다.

reason: Gesturing is bodily movement, not simply spoken calling.

original.en: To ask someone to come or draw his/her attention through words or actions.
original.ko: 말이나 행동으로 다른 사람을 오라고 하거나 주의를 끌다.

proposed.en: Friendly and generous treatment of guests or visitors.
proposed.ko: 손님이나 방문객을 친절하고 후하게 대접하는 환대.

reason: Hospitality specifically concerns welcoming guests rather than general kindness.

original.en: The state of treating someone gently and in a friendly manner, or such an attitude.
original.ko: 사람을 대하는 태도가 상냥하고 부드러움. 또는 그런 태도.

proposed.en: Small amounts of water or other liquid in the air, on a surface or in a substance.
proposed.ko: 공기, 표면이나 물질에 들어 있는 소량의 물기.

reason: The definition repeats moisture rather than naming the liquid.

original.en: The state or quality of being damp due to moisture.
original.ko: 물기가 있어 축축한 기운.

proposed.en: A very small piece or amount of something.
proposed.ko: 아주 작은 조각이나 양.

reason: A small particle is literal; it need not be figurative or an abstract state.

original.en: (figurative) A state of being extremely small or a small thing.
original.ko: (비유적으로) 아주 작거나 적은 것.

proposed.en: An edible seed that develops in a pod underground and often has a thin reddish skin.
proposed.ko: 땅속 꼬투리 안에서 자라며 흔히 얇은 붉은 껍질이 있는 식용 씨앗인 땅콩.

reason: Use savoury rather than savory; peanut is a legume seed, and the rewritten definition aligns with Korean 콩.

original.en: A savory type of reddish brown nut which grows in the soil inside a thick shell and thin inner skin.
original.ko: 땅속에서 나며 두꺼운 껍질 속에 들어 있고, 속껍질이 얇고 붉은 갈색을 띠는, 맛이 고소한 콩.

reason: The source describes a ceremonial procession, not progression; do not silently rename a stable headword.

original.en: A state in which a person who is older or higher in ranking is dressed up and set off on a trip to a place; or a crowd of people gathering to see such a trip.
original.ko: 나이가 많거나 지위가 높은 사람이 차리고 나서서 길을 감. 또는 그때 줄을 지어 이루는 사람들의 무리.

proposed.en: A frame or structure used for holding or storing things.
proposed.ko: 물건을 받치거나 보관하는 틀이나 구조물.

reason: A rack is not necessarily a wall-mounted board; that describes a shelf.

original.en: A long board hung on the wall in order to place objects, etc.
original.ko: 물건 등을 올려 두기 위해 벽에 달아 놓은 긴 널빤지.

proposed.en: To build something again after it has been damaged or destroyed.
proposed.ko: 손상되거나 파괴된 것을 다시 짓다.

reason: Standing something upright again is not sufficient to define rebuild.

original.en: To cause something to stand upright again.
original.ko: 다시 바로 세우다.

original.en: The institution that collects and keeps things that are suddenly needed or not easily obtained and gives them to those who need them.
original.ko: 갑자기 필요해지는 것이나 평소에 쉽게 구할 수 없는 것 등을 모아서 보관해 두었다가 필요한 사람에게 내주는 기관.

proposed.en: A small piece cut from paper or printed material.
proposed.ko: 종이나 인쇄물에서 잘라 낸 작은 조각.

original.en: The act of cutting, pasting, and keeping certain articles or pictures from the newspaper, magazine, etc., or such an article or picture.
original.ko: 신문이나 잡지 등에서, 필요한 글이나 사진을 오려 붙여 보관하는 일. 또는 그런 글이나 사진.

reason: English Wiktionary row82294 explicitly attests scrap verb meaning to scrapbook. The source clipping-and-keeping activity is a legitimate narrow sense.

proposed.en: A surface or area that rises or falls at an angle.
proposed.ko: 비스듬히 올라가거나 내려가는 표면이나 지역.

reason: A slope need not be small or only slightly above ground.

original.en: An area raised slightly higher than the ground level, slanting like a small mountain.
original.ko: 낮은 산처럼 비스듬하게 경사져 있고, 보통 땅보다 약간 높이 솟아 있는 곳.

proposed.en: The measurement of water depth.
proposed.ko: 물의 깊이를 재는 측심.

reason: Sounding is not measurement in general.

original.en: An act of taking the different quantity of something in the same kind, by comparing it with a standard unit.
original.ko: 일정한 양을 기준으로 하여 같은 종류의 다른 양의 크기를 잼.

proposed.en: Rigid and difficult to bend or move.
proposed.ko: 뻣뻣하여 잘 구부러지거나 움직이지 않는.

reason: Rough texture is not necessary for stiffness.

original.en: Feeling hard and rough.
original.ko: 사물의 감촉이 딱딱하고 거칠다.

proposed.en: A football player whose main role is to score goals.
proposed.ko: 주로 골을 넣는 역할을 맡는 축구 공격수.

reason: Reponsible is misspelt; striker is not the usual volleyball position name.

original.en: A player who is reponsible for offense or attacking, and is good at scoring in soccer or volleyball.
original.ko: 축구나 배구에서, 공격을 맡아 득점을 잘하는 선수.

proposed.en: Informal: extremely good.
proposed.ko: 비격식 표현으로, 매우 좋은.

reason: Terrific meaning excellent is informal rather than inherently slang.

original.en: (slang) Very good.
original.ko: (속된 말로) 대단히 좋다.

proposed.en: People who do not have paid work, especially those seeking it; usually the unemployed.
proposed.ko: 보수가 있는 일자리가 없는 사람들. 보통 the unemployed로 쓴다.

original.en: A person who idles away at home without making money because he/she is jobless.
original.ko: 직업이 없어 돈을 벌지 않고 집에서 빈둥거리는 사람.

proposed.en: Former students or graduates of a school, college or university.
proposed.ko: 학교나 대학의 졸업생 또는 이전 재학생들.

original.ko: 같은 학교에서 공부했거나 같은 선생님에게서 배운 사람.

original.en: A person who is fighting. Or a group of fighting opponents.
original.ko: 싸우는 상대인 사람. 또는 싸우는 상대의 무리.

proposed.en: A person or company that arranges transactions between buyers and sellers.
proposed.ko: 구매자와 판매자 사이에서 거래를 중개하는 사람이나 회사.

original.en: An agency that matches people who want to sell or buy, or rent or lease, a house, land, etc.
original.ko: 집이나 토지 등을 사고팔거나 빌리고 빌려주려는 사람들을 서로 소개해 주는 곳.

proposed.en: A large marine fish with a chin barbel, commonly caught for food.
proposed.ko: 턱수염이 있고 식용으로 많이 잡는 큰 바닷물고기인 대구.

reason: Use greyish rather than grayish if retaining original wording.

original.en: A sea fish with a big mouth and small, round scales; it has a light grayish-brown body and a white belly.
original.ko: 엷은 회갈색에 배는 흰색이고 입이 크며 비늘이 작고 둥근 바닷물고기.

proposed.en: The act of using up or eating something.
proposed.ko: 무언가를 사용하여 소모하거나 먹는 행위.

original.en: Having the quality of using something up.

proposed.en: Professional guidance through discussion to help someone deal with problems.
proposed.ko: 문제를 해결하도록 대화를 통해 전문적으로 돕는 상담.

original.ko: 어떤 문제를 해결하기 위해 서로 이야기함.

proposed.en: An expression of goodbye at a parting.
proposed.ko: 헤어질 때 하는 작별 인사.

original.ko: 오랫동안 만나지 못하게 떨어져 있거나 헤어짐.

proposed.ko: 뜨거운 기름이나 지방으로 음식을 익히다.

proposed.en: The act of gaining unauthorised access to a computer system.
proposed.ko: 컴퓨터 시스템에 허가 없이 접근하는 행위.

original.ko: 다른 사람의 컴퓨터 시스템에 침입하여 저장된 정보나 프로그램을 없애거나 망치는 일.

proposed.en: A person who rents out property to tenants, or in British English the owner or manager of a pub.
proposed.ko: 세입자에게 부동산을 임대하는 사람. 또는 영국 영어에서 펍의 주인이나 운영자.

reason: Landlord is not an affectionate title for any male shop owner.

original.en: (affectionate) A man who is the owner of a house, store, etc.
original.ko: (친근하게 이르는 말로) 집이나 가게 등의 주인인 남자.

proposed.en: The act of resting against something.
proposed.ko: 몸을 다른 것에 기대는 행위.

original.ko: 다른 것에 몸을 기댐. 또는 그렇게 하는 대상.

proposed.en: Great unhappiness or suffering.
proposed.ko: 큰 불행이나 고통.

reason: Misery is stronger than merely not being happy.

original.en: The state of not being happy.
original.ko: 행복하지 않음.

proposed.en: A person newly enrolled in an organisation, especially the armed forces.
proposed.ko: 조직, 특히 군대에 새로 들어온 사람.

reason: Recruit noun names the newcomer rather than the act of recruiting.

original.en: The act of opening positions, such as for a job or enterprise, etc., to the public and recruiting.
original.ko: 일반에게 널리 공개하여 모집함.

proposed.ko: 조직이나 일에 필요한 사람을 찾아 뽑다.

reason: Recruiting people differs from collecting goods or works.

original.ko: 사람이나 작품, 물건 등을 일정한 조건에 맞게 널리 알려 뽑거나 모으다.

proposed.en: Honestly and with genuine feeling.
proposed.ko: 거짓 없이 진심으로.

reason: Sincerely concerns sincerity of intention or emotion, not objective factual correctness.

original.ko: 사실이나 이치에 어긋남이 없이 정말로.

proposed.en: A field in which someone has particular expertise.
proposed.ko: 특별한 전문 지식을 가진 분야인 전문 분야.

original.en: The act of researching or studying a certain field in a professional manner, or such a field.
original.ko: 어떤 분야를 전문적으로 연구하거나 공부함. 또는 그 분야.

proposed.en: A burial place for a dead person, often a stone structure.
proposed.ko: 죽은 사람을 묻는 곳으로, 흔히 돌로 만든 무덤.

reason: Tomb is not an honorific word in English.

original.en: (polite form) A person's tomb.
original.ko: (높이는 말로) 사람의 무덤.

proposed.en: A legally protected name, sign or symbol identifying a business’s goods or services.
proposed.ko: 사업체의 상품이나 서비스를 식별하는 법적 보호를 받는 상표.

reason: The source simply repeats trademark.

original.en: A word used to mean a brand or trademark.
original.ko: 상표의 뜻을 나타내는 말.

proposed.en: To make something neat by cutting away small amounts.
proposed.ko: 조금씩 잘라 내어 깔끔하게 다듬다.

reason: Trim is more specific than any cutting.

original.en: To cut an object with a knife or scissors.
original.ko: 칼이나 가위 등으로 물체를 자르다.

proposed.en: A long journey, especially by sea.
proposed.ko: 특히 바다로 떠나는 긴 여행.

reason: Voyage is the journey, not merely its route.

original.en: A course for going a long way.
original.ko: 아주 먼 길을 가는 과정.

proposed.en: The act of saying that someone is responsible for a fault or problem.
proposed.ko: 잘못이나 문제의 책임이 누군가에게 있다고 하는 행위.

reason: Blaming is not limited to scolding a younger person.

original.ko: 아랫사람의 잘못을 꾸짖음.

proposed.en: A stick or block of wax with a wick that burns to give light.
proposed.ko: 빛을 내도록 태우는 심지가 들어 있는 밀랍 등의 덩어리인 양초.

reason: Not everything ignited for light is a candle.

original.ko: 불을 붙여 빛을 내는 것.

proposed.en: A group of people who sing together, especially in church.
proposed.ko: 특히 교회 등에서 함께 노래하는 사람들의 합창단.

reason: Choir is the group, not the act of singing or its song.

original.en: Many people singing together in harmony; or a song sung in such a manner.
original.ko: 여러 사람이 목소리를 맞추어 함께 노래를 부름. 또는 그 노래.

reason: Source defines the space between thumb and fingers, not clutch as a grasp or mechanism; source realignment is needed.

original.en: The part between the thumb and the rest four fingers.
original.ko: 엄지손가락과 다른 네 손가락의 사이.

reason: Impudent behaviour is not a supported general definition of committing; quarantine this source-sense mismatch.

original.en: The act of doing as one wants or behaving impudently.
original.ko: 제멋대로 해 나감. 또는 건방지게 행동함.

proposed.en: Unable to concentrate because attention is drawn elsewhere.

original.ko: 다 뒤섞이거나 뒤얽혀 갈피를 잡을 수 없다.

proposed.en: Informal talk about other people’s private lives, often involving unconfirmed rumours.

proposed.ko: 남의 사생활에 대해 비공식적으로 이야기하다.

proposed.en: A student studying for a first university degree.
proposed.ko: 첫 대학 학위를 위해 공부하는 학부생.

original.en: College, a word used to constrast with graduate school.
original.ko: 대학원과 상대하여 쓰는 말로, 대학.

proposed.en: A heavy radioactive metal used as fuel in nuclear reactors.
proposed.ko: 원자로의 연료로 쓰이는 무거운 방사성 금속인 우라늄.

reason: Uranium is not the heaviest of all known elements.

original.en: A silver-white metal, the heaviest of all elements, used as a raw material for nuclear power generation.
original.ko: 원자력의 원료로 사용되며, 원소 중에서 가장 무거운 은백색의 금속 원소.

proposed.en: A loud shout.
proposed.ko: 큰 외침.

reason: A yell can come from one person, not necessarily many people together.

original.en: A loud sound made by many people shouting or yelling all together.
original.ko: 여러 사람이 함께 큰 소리로 외치거나 지르는 소리.

proposed.en: A notice or message promoting a product, service or event.
proposed.ko: 상품, 서비스나 행사를 홍보하는 광고물이나 메시지.

original.en: The act of making certain information widely known through a television or newspaper, etc.
original.ko: 텔레비전이나 신문 등을 통하여 어떠한 정보를 사람들에게 널리 알리는 활동.

proposed.en: To examine something by separating it into parts or considering its features.
proposed.ko: 어떤 것을 부분으로 나누거나 특징을 살펴 분석하다.

reason: Use analyse rather than analyze.

original.en: To classify a certain phenomenon or object into several elements or traits to better understand it.
original.ko: 더 잘 이해하기 위하여 어떤 현상이나 사물을 여러 요소나 성질로 나누다.

reason: The source describes a box around text, not a bracket; quarantine pending correct sense mapping.

original.en: A space enclosed by four lines used to separate a certain section of writing from the rest of the text.
original.ko: 특별한 내용의 글을 구분하기 위해 사방을 둘러서 막은 선의 안.

proposed.en: A female deer, rabbit or certain other animals.
proposed.ko: 사슴, 토끼 등 특정 동물의 암컷.

reason: Doe is not a universal term for all female animals.

original.en: The female side that gives birth to a baby among sexually dimorphic animals.
original.ko: 암수 구별이 있는 동물 중에 새끼를 배는 쪽.

proposed.en: A desire to have something that someone else has, often with resentment.
proposed.ko: 남이 가진 것을 자신도 갖고 싶어 하는 마음으로, 시기심을 동반하기도 한다.

reason: Envy involves coveting an advantage, not just disliking another’s success.

original.en: A feeling of not liking another's success.
original.ko: 남이 잘되는 것을 싫어하여 미워함.

proposed.en: The state of being forced to live away from one’s home country.
proposed.ko: 고국을 떠나 살도록 강요당한 망명이나 추방 상태.

reason: Exile need not be secret or voluntary flight.

original.en: Leaving one's own country secretly for another country, to avoid suppression or threats one faces due to a political belief, ideology, etc.
original.ko: 정치, 사상 등을 이유로 받는 탄압이나 위협을 피하기 위해 몰래 자기 나라를 떠나 다른 나라로 감.

proposed.en: A waterbird with a long neck, webbed feet and a broad bill.
proposed.ko: 목이 길고 물갈퀴와 넓적한 부리가 있는 물새인 거위류.

reason: Geese are not invariably white with yellow bills.

original.en: A bird which looks like a duck with white feathers, yellow beak, and long neck.
original.ko: 털은 하얗고 부리는 노란색이며 목이 긴, 오리처럼 생긴 새.

proposed.en: A small, simple building used as a shelter.
proposed.ko: 거처나 피난처로 쓰는 작고 간단한 건물인 오두막.

reason: Hut does not mean the person living in it, as Korean currently suggests.

original.en: A small and shabby house that can barely be used as a dwelling.
original.ko: 사람이 겨우 들어가 살 정도로 작고 초라한 집. 또는 그런 집에서 사는 사람.

proposed.en: A harbour with facilities for mooring small boats and yachts.
proposed.ko: 소형 배나 요트를 정박시키는 시설이 있는 항구인 마리나.

reason: A marina is not an aircraft storage place.

original.en: A place where a boat is docked or a plane is kept.
original.ko: 배를 대고 매어 놓는 곳이나 비행기를 두는 곳.

proposed.en: Exclusive or dominant control of a market by one company or group.
proposed.ko: 한 기업이나 집단이 시장을 독점적으로 지배하는 것.

original.en: The domination of a market or commodity to the exclusion of an individual or group, or such an economic phenomenon.
original.ko: 개인이나 한 단체가 생산과 시장을 지배하여 이익을 모두 차지함. 또는 그런 경제 현상.

proposed.en: Careful effort or trouble taken to do something well.
proposed.ko: 어떤 일을 잘하려고 들이는 공이나 수고.

reason: Pains meaning effort is not inherently slang.

original.en: (slang) Trouble.
original.ko: (속된 말로) 수고.

proposed.en: Honest and genuine in feeling or intention.
proposed.ko: 감정이나 의도가 솔직하고 진실한.

reason: The definition repeats sincere and confuses depth with genuineness.

original.en: Heart or attitude being very sincere.
original.ko: 정성이나 마음 등이 아주 깊다.

proposed.en: The violent killing of many people.
proposed.ko: 많은 사람을 폭력적으로 죽이는 학살.

reason: Killling is misspelt; large-scale killing conveys this sense clearly.

original.en: The act of killling people indiscriminately, cruelly and heartlessly.
original.ko: 사람을 매우 모질고 잔인하게 마구 죽임.

proposed.en: A male reproductive cell that can fertilise an egg.
proposed.ko: 난자와 수정할 수 있는 수컷의 생식 세포인 정자.

reason: The original vague source of reproduction does not identify sperm cells.

original.en: The source of an animal's birth and reproduction.
original.ko: 동물을 낳아 번식시키는 근원이 되는 것.

proposed.en: A large waterbird with a long neck, typically white or black.
proposed.ko: 흔히 흰색이나 검은색을 띠며 목이 긴 큰 물새인 백조류.

reason: Not all swans are white or have yellow bills.

original.en: A waterbird with a white body, long neck, yellow beak and black legs.
original.ko: 온몸이 흰색이고 목이 길며 노란 부리와 검은 다리를 가진 물에 사는 새.

proposed.en: To give evidence or make a statement as a witness, especially in court.
proposed.ko: 특히 법정에서 증인으로 진술하거나 증거를 제시하다.

reason: Testifying gives evidence; it does not necessarily establish the truth by proof.

original.en: To establish that an event, some certain content, or a decision is true by presenting proof.
original.ko: 어떤 사건이나 내용이나 판단이 진실인지 아닌지를 증거를 들어서 밝히다.

proposed.en: To allow or endure something unpleasant without stopping it.
proposed.ko: 불쾌한 일을 막지 않고 허용하거나 참다.

original.en: To not make something a problem.
original.ko: 어떤 일을 문제로 만들지 않다.

proposed.en: Liquid waste produced by the kidneys and passed out of the body.
proposed.ko: 신장에서 만들어져 몸 밖으로 배출되는 액체 노폐물인 소변.

original.en: (refined) A person's urine.
original.ko: (점잖게 이르는 말로) 사람의 오줌.

proposed.en: A flavouring obtained from cured vanilla pods.
proposed.ko: 숙성·건조한 바닐라 꼬투리에서 얻는 향료.

reason: Vanilla is not ordinarily described as squeezed fruit juice; use British flavouring.

original.en: A substance obtained by squeezing the fruit of a tropical plant, which is used to flavor confections or ice cream.
original.ko: 열대 식물의 열매에서 짜낸 것으로 과자나 아이스크림에 넣는 향료.

proposed.en: The act of measuring how heavy something is.
proposed.ko: 어떤 것의 무게를 재는 행위.

reason: Weighing is not counting items or measuring volume.

original.en: An act of counting the number of things, or measuring the volume, weight, etc., of things.
original.ko: 수량을 헤아리거나 부피나 무게 등을 잼.

proposed.en: Clapping to show approval, welcome or appreciation.
proposed.ko: 찬성, 환영이나 감사를 나타내려고 박수를 치는 행위.

reason: Clapping solely to keep a beat is not applause.

original.en: Clapping your hands to show welcome or congratulations, or to match the beat.
original.ko: 환영이나 축하 등의 뜻을 나타내거나 박자를 맞추려고 손뼉을 침.

proposed.en: A painful pus-filled swelling caused by an infection in the skin.
proposed.ko: 피부 감염으로 생긴, 고름이 차고 아픈 종기.

original.ko: 피부 속에 병균이 들어가서 생기는 염증.

proposed.en: The act of penetrating an enemy's defence.

original.en: The act of penetrating an enemy's defense.
original.ko: 적진이나 상대의 수비를 뚫고 들어감.

proposed.en: A solid shape with a circular base that narrows to a point.
proposed.ko: 원형 밑면에서 꼭짓점으로 좁아지는 입체인 원뿔.

original.en: A state of looking like a cone.
original.ko: 원뿔 모양으로 된 것.

proposed.en: To communicate an idea, message or feeling.
proposed.ko: 생각, 메시지나 감정을 전달하다.

reason: The existing English repeats convey.

original.ko: 내용이 전달되게 하다.

proposed.en: A sweet dish served at the end of a meal.
proposed.ko: 식사의 끝에 먹는 달콤한 후식.

original.ko: 식사 후에 먹는 간단한 음식.

proposed.ko: 대담하거나 인상적인 행동이나 업적.

original.ko: 싸움이나 어려운 일 등에서 용감하게 활약한 이야기.

proposed.en: A means of access to a place, activity or opportunity.
proposed.ko: 장소, 활동이나 기회에 접근하게 해 주는 통로.

original.en: A harsh process that one needs to go through in order to succeed.
original.ko: 출세하기 위해 거쳐야 하는 어려운 과정.

proposed.en: To suggest a meaning without stating it directly.
proposed.ko: 직접 말하지 않고 뜻을 암시하다.

reason: Imply specifically involves indirect expression.

original.en: To convey a fact or meaning.
original.ko: 어떤 사실이나 내용을 뜻하다.

proposed.en: Freedom from guilt or a lack of experience of wrongdoing.
proposed.ko: 죄가 없거나 나쁜 일에 물들지 않은 순수함.

reason: Genuineness alone does not define innocence.

original.en: The quality of being genuine.
original.ko: 마음이 꾸밈이 없고 참됨.

proposed.en: Socially accepted ways of behaving politely towards others.
proposed.ko: 다른 사람을 예의 바르게 대하는 사회적 행동 방식.

original.ko: 윗사람을 대할 때 지켜야 하는 예의.

proposed.en: Behaving badly or disobediently, especially of a child.
proposed.ko: 특히 아이가 말을 듣지 않거나 장난스럽게 못되게 구는.

original.en: (for one's personality or behavior) Morally bad.
original.ko: 성질이나 하는 행동이 도덕적으로 나쁘다.

proposed.en: A sloping surface joining two different levels.
proposed.ko: 높이가 다른 두 곳을 잇는 경사면.

original.en: A ladder used to ascend to or descend from an airplane or ship.
original.ko: 배나 비행기를 타고 내릴 때 쓰는 사다리.

proposed.en: A ridge of rock, coral or sand at or near the surface of the sea.
proposed.ko: 바다 표면이나 그 가까이에 있는 바위, 산호나 모래의 융기부인 암초.

reason: Reefs need not be invisible or individual rough rocks.

original.en: An invisible, rough rock submerged in the sea or in a river.
original.ko: 바다나 강에서 물속에 잠겨 겉으로 보이지 않는 험한 바위.

proposed.en: To remove a thin layer from a surface with a sharp blade.
proposed.ko: 날카로운 칼날로 표면의 얇은 층을 깎아 내다.

original.en: To remove or wipe off something messy on a floor or surface by rubbing on it.
original.ko: 바닥이나 겉 부분의 지저분한 것을 문질러서 깎거나 닦아 내다.

proposed.en: Illness or a state of being unwell.
proposed.ko: 병이나 몸이 아픈 상태.

reason: English sickness has no honorific register.

original.en: (honorific) A disease.
original.ko: (높임말로) 병.

proposed.en: A written law formally enacted by a legislature.
proposed.ko: 입법 기관이 공식적으로 제정한 성문 법률.

original.en: A piece of writing that contains laws and orders.
original.ko: 법과 명령을 적어 놓은 글.

proposed.en: A young child who has recently learned to walk.
proposed.ko: 걷기를 배운 지 얼마 되지 않은 어린아이.

reason: Toddler is narrower than all preschool children.

original.en: A young child before school age.
original.ko: 아직 학교에 들어가지 않은, 나이가 적은 아이.

proposed.en: Deliberately cruel or violently aggressive.
proposed.ko: 고의로 잔인하거나 폭력적으로 공격적인.

reason: Vicious is stronger than presumptuous or rough.

original.en: One's personality being presumptuous and rough.
original.ko: 성질이 엉큼하고 거칠다.

proposed.en: Completely or entirely.
proposed.ko: 완전히 또는 전적으로.

reason: Wholly does not imply preserving an original condition.

original.en: In a manner of something being intact as it originally was.
original.ko: 본래의 모습 그대로 고스란히.

proposed.en: Happening by chance or without intention.
proposed.ko: 우연히 또는 의도하지 않게 일어나는.

reason: The adjective is not naturally defined by there are times when.

original.en: There are times when things happen for no apparent reason.
original.ko: 어떤 일이 마땅한 이유 없이 어쩌다가 일어나는 면이 있다.

proposed.en: The deliberate killing of a prominent person, often for political reasons.
proposed.ko: 흔히 정치적 이유로 저명한 인물을 고의로 죽이는 암살.

reason: Assassinations are not necessarily carried out secretly.

original.en: The act of secretly killing someone, who is important usually in politics.
original.ko: 주로 정치적으로 중요한 사람을 몰래 죽임.

proposed.en: A group of people gathered for religious worship.
proposed.ko: 종교 의식을 위해 모인 신자들의 집단.

reason: Korean currently defines religious influence or circumstances rather than worshippers.

original.en: The people who regularly worship; the people who collectively assist the status or the power of a religion.
original.ko: 종교의 상황이나 세력.

proposed.en: To organise activities or people so they work together effectively.
proposed.ko: 활동이나 사람들이 효과적으로 함께 움직이도록 조정하다.

reason: Use British harmonise if retaining source; definition clarifies coordinating rather than merely joining forces.

original.en: To join forces to harmonize with one another.
original.ko: 힘을 합쳐 서로 조화를 이루다.

proposed.en: A solid shape with six equal square faces.
proposed.ko: 크기가 같은 여섯 정사각형 면으로 이루어진 정육면체.

reason: English must specify squares, matching Korean, rather than any regular polygons.

original.en: A regular polyhedron composed of six regular polygons of the same size and shape.
original.ko: 크기와 모양이 같은 여섯 개의 정사각형으로 이루어진 정다면체.

proposed.en: The act of making something more attractive, or an ornament used for this.
proposed.ko: 더 보기 좋게 꾸미는 일이나 그에 쓰는 장식.

reason: Decoration does not inherently imply a deceptive surface appearance.

original.en: An act of making something look or sound good on the surface only.
original.ko: 겉으로만 그럴듯하게 꾸밈.

proposed.en: A payment to shareholders from a company’s profits.
proposed.ko: 회사의 이익에서 주주에게 지급하는 배당금.

reason: A dividend is not any money divided among people.

original.en: A sum of money fixed and distributed among a number of people according to a certain standard.
original.ko: 일정한 기준에 따라 몫을 정하여 나누어 주는 돈.

proposed.en: Slow movement caused by wind or water currents.
proposed.ko: 바람이나 물살에 의해 천천히 떠밀리는 이동.

reason: Drift is the movement rather than wind and tide themselves.

original.en: Wind and tide, or the tide flowing in the direction of the wind.
original.ko: 바람과 바닷물. 또는 바람에 따라 흐르는 바닷물.

proposed.en: To give something a colour using a colouring substance.
proposed.ko: 염료를 사용하여 어떤 것에 색을 들이다.

reason: The definition repeats dye.

original.en: To dye something a specific colour.
original.ko: 색감을 스며들게 하다.

proposed.en: A negatively charged subatomic particle found in atoms.
proposed.ko: 원자에 존재하는 음전하를 띤 아원자 입자인 전자.

reason: Electrons are not simply tiny bodies revolving around the nucleus on fixed classical paths.

original.en: In physics, a small particle that has a negative charge and is the most basic unit within an atom that revolves around the nucleus of the atom.
original.ko: 물리에서, 한 원자 속에서 음의 성질 띠고 원자의 핵의 둘레를 도는 가장 기본적인 단위로 설정된 작은 입자.

proposed.en: To bear pain, difficulty or something unpleasant without giving up.
proposed.ko: 고통이나 어려움, 불쾌한 일을 포기하지 않고 견디다.

reason: Endure does not ordinarily mean suppressing laughter or coughing.

original.en: To suppress and endure physiological phenomena such as laughter, crying, pain, coughing, etc.
original.ko: 웃음, 눈물, 아픔, 기침 등과 같은 생리적인 현상을 억누르고 견디다.

proposed.en: Not sufficient or good enough for a purpose.
proposed.ko: 목적에 비추어 충분하지 않거나 적절한 수준에 못 미치는.

reason: Inadequate is insufficiency rather than merely bad timing.

original.en: A situation or timing being unsuitable for doing something.
original.ko: 어떤 일을 하기에는 상황이나 시기가 적절하지 아니하다.

proposed.en: On purpose rather than by accident.
proposed.ko: 우연이 아니라 일부러.

reason: Intentionally does not mean concealing one’s intention.

original.en: With one's real purpose or intention hidden.
original.ko: 알면서도 아는 것을 숨기거나 어떤 행위를 하는 본래 마음을 숨기고.

proposed.ko: 주의를 다른 곳으로 돌리는 일이나 그런 방해 요소.

reason: Distraction specifically diverts attention, not every kind of obstruction.

original.en: The act of interfering and hindering work from being done properly.
original.ko: 일이 제대로 되지 못하도록 간섭하고 막음.

proposed.en: To free someone from an obligation, payment or rule.
proposed.ko: 의무, 납부나 규칙의 적용에서 면제하다.

reason: Exempt means release from, not merely reduce.

original.en: To reduce or exempt someone from taxes, tuition or punishment.
original.ko: 세금이나 학비, 형벌 등을 줄이거나 면제하다.

proposed.en: A mass of small bubbles on or in a liquid.
proposed.ko: 액체 표면이나 안에 모인 작은 거품 덩어리.

reason: A single bubble is not foam.

original.en: An empty, round drop of liquid, containing air in it.
original.ko: 액체 속에 공기가 들어가 만들어진 속이 빈 둥근 방울.

proposed.en: The chemical processes in a living organism that sustain life.
proposed.ko: 생물의 생명을 유지하는 화학 작용인 물질대사.

reason: Use synthesise if retaining source; concise definition avoids conflating all metabolism with excretion.

original.en: The process by which living organisms break down or synthesize nutrients to generate the energy needed by the body and expel unnecessary substances out of the body.
original.ko: 생물체가 영양물을 분해 또는 합성하여 몸에 필요한 에너지를 생성하고 불필요한 물질을 몸 밖으로 내보내는 작용.

proposed.en: A flightless seabird of the Southern Hemisphere that swims using its flippers.
proposed.ko: 날지 못하며 지느러미 모양의 날개로 헤엄치는 남반구의 바닷새인 펭귄.

reason: Penguins are not all Antarctic; several species live in temperate or tropical areas.

original.en: A bird living in groups in the south pole region, which cannot fly and which walks with two feet and swims well.
original.ko: 날지 못하고 두 발로 걸으며 헤엄을 잘 치는, 남극 지방에 무리 지어 사는 새.

proposed.en: Widespread or common in a particular place or time.
proposed.ko: 특정 장소나 시기에 널리 퍼져 있거나 흔한.

reason: Prevalent does not entail rapid spread or lack of control.

original.en: A fashion, ideology, force, etc., spreading fast and thus being uncontrollable.
original.ko: 유행, 사상, 세력 등이 빠르게 퍼져서 걷잡을 수가 없다.

proposed.en: To state or identify something clearly and precisely.
proposed.ko: 어떤 것을 명확하고 구체적으로 명시하다.

reason: Pledging one’s name does not define specify.

original.en: To pledge by one's name or specify conditions.
original.ko: 이름이나 조건을 내세우다.

proposed.en: To pierce or wound with a pointed weapon, especially a knife.
proposed.ko: 특히 칼과 같은 뾰족한 무기로 찌르거나 상처를 내다.

reason: Stab need not be repeated and is not knuckling.

original.en: To repeatedly prod, knuckle, or spear something severely or deeply.
original.ko: 크게 또는 깊이 계속해서 찌르거나 박거나 찍다.

proposed.en: The total value of a business’s sales during a period.
proposed.ko: 일정 기간 동안의 총매출액.

reason: Turnover does not mean all invested money has been recovered or every item sold.

original.en: A state in which all of the investment has been recovered or products are sold out during a certain period of time.
original.ko: 투자한 자금이 모두 되돌아오는 것. 또는 구입한 상품이 모두 팔리는 것.

proposed.en: A spirit distilled from fermented grain and usually matured in wooden casks.
proposed.ko: 발효한 곡물을 증류하고 보통 나무통에서 숙성시킨 술인 위스키.

reason: Distillation is essential; whiskey is legitimate Irish/US spelling, so retain it with whisky alias rather than mechanically rename.

original.en: A western liquor made by fermenting barley, wheat, sorghum, etc., with yeast.
original.ko: 보리, 밀, 수수 등을 효모로 발효시켜 만든 서양 술.

proposed.en: A quality or characteristic of someone or something.
proposed.ko: 사람이나 사물의 속성이나 특징.

reason: Attributes are not restricted to physical shape.

original.en: The shape and quality of an object.
original.ko: 사물의 생긴 모양과 성질.

proposed.en: To cut something with repeated blows of a sharp tool.
proposed.ko: 날카로운 도구로 내려쳐 잘라 내다.

reason: Chop is cutting by blows, not stabbing with a point.

original.en: To hit or stab something with a bladed tool, sharp object, etc.
original.ko: 날이 있는 연장 등으로 내리치거나 끝이 뾰족한 것으로 찌르다.

proposed.en: To complete something or make it better by fitting well with it.
proposed.ko: 잘 어울려 어떤 것을 완성하거나 더 좋게 만들다.

reason: Complement is not simply adding missing text, which is closer to supplement.

original.en: To add the lacking content of a writing or book.
original.ko: 글이나 책의 부족한 내용을 보충하다.

proposed.en: One numeral in a number, such as 0, 1 or 2.
proposed.ko: 0, 1, 2처럼 수를 이루는 개별 숫자.

reason: Digit is one numeral, not the count of numerals.

original.en: The number of numerals that form a figure.
original.ko: 어떤 수를 이루는 숫자의 개수.

proposed.en: A member of a group of reptiles that included many prehistoric land animals; birds descend from this group.
proposed.ko: 여러 선사시대 육상 동물을 포함하는 파충류 집단의 구성원인 공룡. 새는 이 집단에서 유래했다.

reason: Dinosaurs were not all huge; simply any huge extinct creature is also too broad.

original.en: A huge creature that lived on this earth a long time ago but is extinct now.
original.ko: 아주 오래전에 땅 위에서 살다가 지금은 없어진, 몸이 아주 큰 동물.

proposed.en: Breathing impairment caused by being submerged in liquid, which may be fatal.
proposed.ko: 액체에 잠겨 호흡에 장애가 생기는 익수로, 사망에 이를 수 있다.

reason: Drowning need not be fatal; the existing definition is also circular.

original.en: A death by drowning.
original.ko: 물에 빠져 죽음.

proposed.en: A strongly fortified building or place used for defence.
proposed.ko: 방어를 위해 튼튼하게 요새화한 건물이나 장소.

reason: Use defence in British English.

original.en: A defense facility strongly built in a militarily key location, or a place that houses such a facility.
original.ko: 군사적으로 중요한 곳에 튼튼하게 만들어 놓은 방어 시설. 또는 그런 시설을 한 곳.

proposed.en: A group of animals of one kind that live or move together.
proposed.ko: 같은 종류의 동물이 함께 살거나 움직이는 무리.

reason: A herd is not an ecological community of many different species.

original.en: Various kinds of living things living in one place, related to each other.
original.ko: 한곳에 모여 살면서 서로 관계를 가지고 생활하는 여러 종류의 생물들.

proposed.en: Not enough for a particular purpose.
proposed.ko: 특정 목적에 필요한 만큼 충분하지 않은.

reason: Insufficient is about amount or adequacy, not all kinds of dissatisfaction.

original.en: Not satisfactory.
original.ko: 만족스럽지 못하다.

proposed.en: The unlawful taking or holding of a person against their will.
proposed.ko: 본인의 의사에 반하여 사람을 불법으로 데려가거나 붙잡아 두는 납치.

reason: Kidnapping is not restricted to deceiving children or demanding money.

original.en: Primarily to lure children by deceiving them for the purpose of demanding money, etc.
original.ko: 돈 등을 요구할 목적으로, 주로 아이를 속여서 유인함.

proposed.en: A fungus that grows as a fuzzy layer on damp or decaying material.
proposed.ko: 습하거나 썩는 물질에 솜털 같은 층으로 자라는 균인 곰팡이.

reason: Use mould and specify fungus rather than any microorganism.

original.en: Microorganism that forms in wet, warm places and makes things or food stale.
original.ko: 물기가 있고 따뜻한 곳에서 생겨 물건이나 음식물을 상하게 하는 미생물.

proposed.en: The state of being against a certain behaviour, opinion, etc., without following it.

reason: The definition is semantically acceptable; use the app’s British English spelling: behavior → behaviour.

original.en: The state of being against a certain behavior, opinion, etc., without following it.
original.ko: 어떤 행동이나 의견 등을 따르지 않고 거스름.

proposed.en: A person’s or animal’s children or young.
proposed.ko: 사람이나 동물의 자식이나 새끼.

reason: Korean currently describes distant descendants after many generations rather than direct offspring.

original.en: Children born after one's generation.
original.ko: 자신의 세대에서 여러 세대가 지난 뒤의 자녀를 통틀어 이르는 말.

proposed.en: Shockingly unacceptable or excessive.
proposed.ko: 충격적일 정도로 용납할 수 없거나 지나친.

reason: Outrageous is not necessarily violent and should not be defined through a mental-illness slur.

original.en: Someone's behavior or personality being very violent, like that of a crazy person.
original.ko: 행동이나 성격이 미친 것처럼 매우 사납다.

proposed.en: An official rule or act that forbids something.
proposed.ko: 어떤 일을 금지하는 공식 규칙이나 금지 행위.

reason: Prohibition forbids an action rather than merely enforcing compliance with any rule.

original.en: The act of preventing someone from breaking a rule or custom, or such a prevention.
original.ko: 일정한 규칙이나 관습을 어기지 못하게 함. 또는 그런 일.

proposed.en: In the expression relieve oneself, to urinate or defecate.
proposed.ko: relieve oneself라는 표현에서, 대소변을 보다.

reason: The bodily-function sense requires the reflexive construction.

original.en: (euphemism) To defecate or urinate.
original.ko: (완곡한 말로) 똥이나 오줌을 싸다.

proposed.en: To a noticeable or unusual degree.
proposed.ko: 눈에 띄거나 특이할 정도로.

reason: Remarkably is not limited to a decline in grades or strength.

original.en: In the manner that a grade, ranking, etc., falls or a degree gets weak very conspicuously.
original.ko: 성적이나 순위 등이 눈에 띄게 몹시 떨어지거나 정도가 아주 약해지는 모양.

proposed.en: A mark left on the skin after a wound has healed.
proposed.ko: 상처가 아문 뒤 피부에 남는 흉터.

reason: Fresh cuts and bruises are not scars.

original.en: Cuts and bruises caused by being injured.
original.ko: 몸을 다쳐서 상한 자리.

proposed.en: A method of reproducing sound through two or more channels to give a sense of direction.
proposed.ko: 두 개 이상의 채널로 방향감을 살려 소리를 재생하는 스테레오 방식.

reason: English says more than two while Korean correctly says two or more.

original.en: A method of playing sound three-dimensionally using more than two speakers in broadcasts, records, etc., or such a device.
original.ko: 방송이나 레코드 등에서 두 개 이상의 스피커를 사용해서 음향을 입체적으로 재생하는 방식. 또는 그런 장치.

proposed.en: A substantial musical composition for an orchestra, usually in several movements.
proposed.ko: 보통 여러 악장으로 이루어진 큰 규모의 관현악곡인 교향곡.

reason: Not all music for multiple instruments is a symphony.

original.en: Music played with all kinds of instruments, such as wind, percussion, string instruments, etc.
original.ko: 관악기, 타악기, 현악기 등 여러 가지 악기로 함께 연주하는 음악.

proposed.en: A person who buys and sells goods or financial assets.
proposed.ko: 상품이나 금융 자산을 사고파는 거래자.

reason: A trader is not every business manager.

original.en: A person who runs a business.
original.ko: 사업을 직접 경영하는 사람.

proposed.en: A blood vessel that carries blood towards the heart.
proposed.ko: 혈액을 심장 쪽으로 운반하는 혈관인 정맥.

reason: The original describes all blood vessels and omits the distinction from arteries.

original.en: A tube in the body through which the blood flows.
original.ko: 몸속에서 피가 흐르는 관.

proposed.en: A small animal with a long, soft body and no legs.
proposed.ko: 길고 부드러운 몸에 다리가 없는 작은 동물인 벌레류.

reason: Worm does not generally include adult insects.

original.en: An animal whose body has a simple structure, such as an insect or parasite.
original.ko: 곤충이나 기생충 등 몸 구조가 간단한 동물.

proposed.en: Funny or entertaining.
proposed.ko: 웃기거나 재미있는.

reason: Candid and appealing speech is not necessarily amusing.

original.en: A person's remark, story, etc., being candid and appealing.
original.ko: 말, 이야기 등이 꾸밈이 없고 마음을 끄는 맛이 있다.

proposed.en: A person whose wealth is at least one billion units of a currency.
proposed.ko: 재산이 특정 통화로 최소 10억 단위에 이르는 억만장자.

reason: Billionaire has a numeric threshold, not incalculable wealth.

original.en: A person who has an incalculably enormous amount of wealth.
original.ko: 셀 수 없을 만큼 많은 재산을 가진 사람.

proposed.en: A substance that speeds up a chemical reaction without being consumed in it.
proposed.ko: 반응에서 소모되지 않으면서 화학 반응 속도를 높이는 촉매.

reason: The definition merely repeats catalyst.

original.en: A substance used in a process as a catalyst.
original.ko: 촉매에 쓰이는 물질.

proposed.en: An element that makes up about 78% of air and is a colourless, odourless gas at room temperature.
proposed.ko: 공기의 약 78%를 이루며 상온에서 무색무취 기체인 원소인 질소.

reason: Use odourless rather than odorless.

original.en: An element that constitutes nearly 78% of the air, occurring as a colourless, odorless, and tasteless gas at room temperature.
original.ko: 상온에서 기체 상태로 존재하며 공기의 약 78%를 이루는, 색깔이나 냄새, 맛이 없는 원소.

proposed.en: Skilful and refined, without awkwardness.
proposed.ko: 어색함 없이 능숙하고 세련된.

reason: Piece or writing is a typo for piece of writing.

original.en: A remark, piece or writing, behavior, etc., being great and sophisticated, not clumsy or awkward.
original.ko: 말이나 글, 행동 등이 서투르거나 어색하지 않고 훌륭하고 능숙하다.

proposed.en: To count or calculate.
proposed.ko: 수를 세거나 계산하다.

reason: Reckon is not restricted to abacuses or sticks.

original.en: To count numbers by using an abacus, sticks, etc.
original.ko: 수판이나 막대기 등을 이용하여 수를 세다.

proposed.en: The sending of goods, or a consignment of goods being sent.
proposed.ko: 상품을 보내는 일이나 보내는 화물.

reason: Shipment is not limited to the physical act of loading a ship.

original.en: The act of loading freight on a ship.
original.ko: 배에 짐을 실음.

proposed.en: Informal: stubbornness.
proposed.ko: 비격식 표현으로, 고집스러움.

reason: Wiktionary row92829 attests the noun stubborn as informal stubbornness. Keep noun and use informal rather than transferred Korean slang.

original.en: (slang) Very strong stubbornness.
original.ko: (속된 말로) 매우 센 고집.

proposed.en: To move a plant and put it in soil in a different place.
proposed.ko: 식물을 옮겨 다른 곳에 심다.

reason: The definition repeats transplant without explaining replanting.

original.en: To transplant rice or young plants.
original.ko: 모나 어린 식물 등을 옮겨 심다.

reason: The source describes boarding steps, probably a Korean 트랩 loanword; English traps does not have that ordinary meaning.

original.en: A ladder used to ascend to or descend from an airplane or ship.
original.ko: 배나 비행기를 타고 내릴 때 쓰는 사다리.

proposed.en: Grass together with the surface layer of soil held by its roots.
proposed.ko: 잔디와 그 뿌리에 붙은 표토층.

reason: Turf includes the rooted surface layer; grass have is also ungrammatical.

original.en: Grass that have short, narrow leaves, grow close together, and are planted in a garden, park, golf links, etc.
original.ko: 정원, 공원, 골프장 등에 심는 잎이 짧고 가늘며, 촘촘하게 자라는 풀.

proposed.en: In the manner of a state, one's personality, behaviour, etc., being very uncommon.

reason: The definition is semantically acceptable; use the app’s British English spelling: behavior → behaviour.

original.en: In the manner of a state, one's personality, behavior, etc., being very uncommon.
original.ko: 상태나 성격, 행동 등이 보통과 아주 다르게.

proposed.en: An opening in the Earth’s crust through which lava, ash and gases escape, often forming a mountain.
proposed.ko: 용암, 재와 가스가 나오는 지각의 구멍으로, 흔히 산을 이루는 화산.

reason: The volcanic eruption event is not itself a volcano.

original.en: A phenomenon in which gas or lava underground bursts out through the ground. Or a mountain formed as a result.
original.ko: 땅속에 있는 가스나 용암이 땅을 뚫고 터져 나오는 현상. 또는 그로 인해 생긴 산.

proposed.en: The act of taking money or goods temporarily with an obligation to return them.
proposed.ko: 돌려줄 의무를 지고 돈이나 물건을 잠시 빌리는 행위.

reason: Borrowing does not mean lending.

original.en: An act of lending or borrowing money or goods.
original.ko: 돈이나 물건을 빌려주거나 빌림.

proposed.en: A person whose job is preparing and selling meat or slaughtering animals for meat.
proposed.ko: 고기를 손질하고 팔거나 식육용 동물을 도살하는 사람.

reason: Butcher is current English, not archaic simply because the Korean source is historical.

original.en: (archaic) In old times, a person who slaughtered animals such as cows, pigs, etc., for a living.
original.ko: (옛날에) 소나 돼지 등의 가축을 잡는 일을 직업으로 하던 사람.

proposed.en: To kill and prepare an animal for meat.
proposed.ko: 고기를 얻기 위해 동물을 도살하고 손질하다.

reason: Butcher is more specific than any killing of an animal.

original.en: To kill an animal.
original.ko: 짐승을 죽이다.

proposed.en: The beginning of pregnancy when fertilisation occurs.
proposed.ko: 수정으로 임신이 시작되는 수태.

reason: Conception is the beginning, not the whole state of pregnancy.

original.en: The state of bearing a child or young in the womb.
original.ko: 배 속에 아이나 새끼가 생김.

proposed.en: A person with dwarfism; use with care because some people find this term offensive.
proposed.ko: 왜소증이 있는 사람을 가리키는 말로, 불쾌하게 느끼는 사람도 있어 주의가 필요하다.

reason: Unlike normal people stigmatises people with dwarfism and should not be a learner definition.

original.en: (disparaging) A person of very short stature unlike normal people.
original.ko: (낮잡아 이르는 말로) 정상인과 달리 키가 매우 작은 사람.

proposed.en: The most important or representative product, service or establishment of an organisation.
proposed.ko: 조직을 대표하는 가장 중요하거나 뛰어난 제품, 서비스나 시설.

reason: Flagship in this sense is a leading offering rather than an abstract force.

original.en: A power or force that is the head and serves as the centre of something.
original.ko: 중심이 되는 힘이나 세력.

proposed.en: Shining warmly or appearing radiant.
proposed.ko: 따뜻한 빛을 내거나 환하게 빛나는.

reason: Glowing is not restricted to fresh plant leaves.

original.en: A leaf or branch of a plant looking fresh and glossy.
original.ko: 식물의 잎이나 줄기가 싱싱하고 윤기가 있다.

proposed.en: To pierce or wound with a horn or tusk.
proposed.ko: 뿔이나 엄니로 찔러 상처를 내다.

reason: Goring pierces with a horn or tusk; merely butting with a head is not enough.

original.en: To hit someone or something hard with a head, horn, etc.
original.ko: 머리나 뿔 등으로 세게 부딪치다.

proposed.en: A long ceremonial robe, such as one worn at graduation.
proposed.ko: 졸업식 등에서 입는 긴 예복.

reason: Outwear is a typo for outerwear.

original.en: Long cape-shaped outwear used for official or ceremonial occasions such as graduation, religious rituals, etc.
original.ko: 졸업식, 종교 의식 등의 예식이나 행사에서 입는 긴 망토 모양의 겉옷.

proposed.en: A sedimentary rock made mainly of calcium carbonate.
proposed.ko: 주로 탄산 칼슘으로 이루어진 퇴적암인 석회암.

reason: Not all limestone forms from accumulated animal remains.

original.en: A sedimentary rock with calcium carbonate as its main component, made by skins or bones of animals piling up under the water.
original.ko: 동물의 뼈나 껍질이 물 밑에 쌓여서 생긴, 탄산 칼슘을 주성분으로 하는 퇴적암.

reason: Definition describes mashing or pounding material soft, not meshing/interlocking. Likely mesh/mash confusion.

original.en: To make a tough object smooth by beating or pressing it.
original.ko: 억센 물건을 두드리거나 짓이겨 부드럽게 하다.

proposed.en: A person who moves from one place to another to live or work.
proposed.ko: 살거나 일하기 위해 한 곳에서 다른 곳으로 옮기는 이주민.

reason: Migration can take place within one country.

original.en: A person who leaves one's own country and goes to another country to live.
original.ko: 자기 나라를 떠나서 다른 나라로 가서 사는 사람.

reason: Romanised Korean 낱 counting unit has been imported as nat; English nat information-unit sense is unrelated.

original.en: A unit of counting very slim or small things that exist separately among many.
original.ko: 여럿 가운데 따로따로인, 아주 가늘거나 작은 것을 하나하나 세는 단위.

proposed.en: In baseball, throwing the ball towards the batter.
proposed.ko: 야구에서 타자를 향해 공을 던지는 투구.

reason: Bowling delivery is not normally called pitching, and pitching is the action rather than the ball.

original.en: In baseball, bowling, etc., an act of throwing a ball, or such a ball.
original.ko: 야구나 볼링 등에서 공을 던짐. 또는 그 공.

proposed.en: Respect and admiration associated with success, status or reputation.
proposed.ko: 성공, 지위나 명성 때문에 얻는 존경과 위신.

reason: Prestige is social esteem, not simply a praiseworthy feature.

original.en: The quality of serving as a role model or being a source of pride.
original.ko: 모범이 되거나 자랑할 만한 점.

proposed.en: A connection with the matter being considered.
proposed.ko: 검토하는 문제와의 관련성.

reason: Relevance does not require mutual influence between two entities.

original.en: The nature of two or more people, objects, phenomena, etc. forming a relationship in which they influence each other.
original.ko: 둘 이상의 사람, 사물, 현상 등이 서로 영향을 주고받도록 관계를 맺는 성질.

proposed.en: A person or business that sells goods directly to consumers.
proposed.ko: 소비자에게 상품을 직접 파는 사람이나 소매업체.

reason: A retailer is the seller, not the activity of retailing.

original.en: The business of buying a product from the manufacturer and selling it directly to a consumer, or a person in such a business.
original.ko: 물건을 생산자에게서 사서 소비자에게 파는 장사. 또는 그런 사람.

proposed.en: Strict and unwilling to change.
proposed.ko: 엄격하고 바꾸려 하지 않는.

reason: Rigid does not imply morally right.

original.en: Strict and right.
original.ko: 엄격하고 바르다.

proposed.en: A photograph that a person takes of themselves, usually with a phone.
proposed.ko: 보통 휴대전화로 자신을 직접 찍은 사진인 셀피.

reason: Selfie is not an abbreviation of self-camera; that explanation belongs to Korean 셀카. It names the photo, not the act.

original.en: An abbreviation for 'self-camera', the act of taking a photo or video of oneself.
original.ko: ‘셀프 카메라’를 줄여 이르는 말로, 자기 자신을 사진이나 동영상으로 찍는 일.

proposed.en: The distance between two opposite surfaces of an object.
proposed.ko: 물체의 서로 마주 보는 두 표면 사이의 두께.

reason: The current definition repeats thickness.

original.en: The degree of thickness of an object.
original.ko: 사물의 두꺼운 정도.

proposed.en: To make practical use of something.
proposed.ko: 어떤 것을 실용적으로 활용하다.

reason: Use utilise in British English.

original.en: To use something as occasion demands in a way that is helpful or beneficial to one.
original.ko: 대상을 필요에 따라 이롭거나 쓸모가 있게 쓰다.

proposed.en: The feeling of looking forward to or expecting something.
proposed.ko: 어떤 일을 기대하거나 기다리는 마음.

reason: Anticipation is the expectation, not the awaited object.

original.en: A thing that many people anxiously wait and hope for.
original.ko: 많은 사람들이 몹시 기다리고 바라는 것.

proposed.en: Official permission or approval to do something.
proposed.ko: 어떤 일을 하도록 주는 공식적인 허가나 승인.

reason: Use authorisation; permission need not be an exception to an otherwise illegal act.

original.en: The act of allowing someone to perform certain acts forbidden by law, only in certain special cases.
original.ko: 법에 의해 금지되어 있는 행위를 특정한 경우에 한해 허용하여 이를 행할 수 있게 함.

proposed.en: A short explanation of essential information, or a meeting where it is given.
proposed.ko: 핵심 정보를 간단히 설명하는 브리핑이나 그 회의.

reason: Use summarises rather than summarizes if retaining source wording.

original.en: A brief report or explanation that summarizes key points, or a document or meeting for such a report or explanation.
original.ko: 요점을 간추린 간단한 보고나 설명. 또는 그런 보고나 설명을 하기 위한 문서나 모임.

proposed.en: A dark, sweet fizzy drink with a distinctive flavour.
proposed.ko: 특유의 맛이 나는 검고 달콤한 탄산음료인 콜라.

reason: Use flavour in British English.

original.en: Blackish soda, with a sweet flavor and unique scent.
original.ko: 맛이 달고 독특한 향이 나는 검은색의 탄산음료.

proposed.en: The study of relationships between organisms and their environment.
proposed.ko: 생물과 환경의 관계를 연구하는 생태학.

reason: Ecology is not merely one organism’s manner of living.

original.en: The way or state in which an organism lives.
original.ko: 생물이 살아가는 모양이나 상태.

proposed.en: To an unusually great degree, or in an unusual way.
proposed.ko: 특별히 큰 정도로 또는 이례적으로.

reason: Exceptionally is not restricted to differences between people.

original.en: Differently from ordinary people.
original.ko: 보통의 사람과 많이 다르게.

proposed.en: Money spent, or the act of spending it.
proposed.ko: 지출한 돈이나 돈을 쓰는 행위.

reason: Expenditure is actual spending, not necessarily anticipated cost.

original.en: Money necessary for doing something.
original.ko: 어떤 일을 하는 데 필요한 비용.

proposed.en: Romantic or sexual attraction to people of the same sex.
proposed.ko: 같은 성별의 사람에게 느끼는 낭만적 또는 성적 끌림.

reason: Homosexuality is an orientation or pattern of attraction, not just any love between two people.

original.en: Love between two same-sex people.
original.ko: 남자끼리 또는 여자끼리 같은 성 사이의 사랑.

proposed.en: A person newly admitted to a group or introduced to a subject.
proposed.ko: 집단에 새로 입문하거나 어떤 분야를 처음 배우는 사람.

reason: Initiate as a noun denotes the newcomer, not starting motion.

original.en: The act of moving for the first time, or to make this happen.
original.ko: 처음으로 움직이기 시작함. 또는 그렇게 되게 함.

proposed.en: To start a process or activity.
proposed.ko: 과정이나 활동을 시작하다.

reason: Initiate does not require acting towards another person before they act.

original.en: To do something to someone before he/she attempts the same thing.
original.ko: 다른 사람을 향해 먼저 어떤 행동을 하다.

proposed.en: A brief downward and upward movement of the head.
proposed.ko: 머리를 짧게 아래위로 움직여 끄덕이는 동작.

reason: A sideways headshake is not a nod.

original.en: Nodding or shaking your head.
original.ko: 고개를 끄덕이거나 흔듦.

proposed.en: Having a powerful effect.
proposed.ko: 강력한 효과나 영향력이 있는.

reason: Potent need not be excessive or describe taste or smell.

original.en: The taste, smell, etc., being too strong.
original.ko: 맛이나 냄새 등이 지나치게 자극적이다.

proposed.en: The reddish-brown coating formed when iron reacts with oxygen and moisture.
proposed.ko: 철이 산소와 수분에 반응하여 생기는 붉은 갈색의 녹.

reason: The source generalises all metal corrosion, including blue patina, as rust.

original.en: A red, black, or blue substance that appears on the surface of a piece of iron due to oxidation.
original.ko: 산화 작용 때문에 쇠붙이의 겉에 생기는 붉거나 검거나 푸른 물질.

proposed.en: For iron or steel to develop rust.
proposed.ko: 철이나 강철에 녹이 슬다.

reason: Wood becomes rotten or brittle; it does not rust.

original.en: For a metal object to rust badly or for a wooden item to become fragile.
original.ko: 쇠붙이가 녹이 심하게 슬거나 나무로 된 것이 부스러지기 쉬운 상태가 되다.

proposed.en: To move away from the correct or intended path.
proposed.ko: 올바르거나 의도한 길에서 벗어나다.

reason: Straying is departure from the path, not merely failing to find a destination.

original.en: To fail to find the way to one's destination.
original.ko: 가려고 하던 길을 찾지 못하게 되다.

proposed.en: To cover or decorate something with many small objects.
proposed.ko: 작은 물건들을 많이 박거나 배치하여 덮거나 장식하다.

reason: Stud implies objects fixed or dotted on a surface, not simply scattered loose.

original.en: To scatter something everywhere.
original.ko: 여기저기 흩어지게 뿌리다.

proposed.en: The speed or pace of music or another activity.
proposed.ko: 음악이나 활동이 진행되는 속도.

reason: Tempo is not a compound noun composed of slowness and fastness; that description transfers Korean structure.

original.en: A compound noun meaning slowness and fastness.
original.ko: 느림과 빠름.

proposed.en: In a vertical position.
proposed.ko: 수직으로 똑바로 선.

reason: Upright specifies vertical orientation, not any straight road or line.

original.en: A road, line, posture, etc., being straight, not bent.
original.ko: 길, 선, 자세 등이 휘지 않고 똑바르다.

proposed.en: In or into a vertical position.
proposed.ko: 수직으로 똑바로 서서 또는 세워서.

reason: A straight horizontal line is not upright.

original.en: In a straight line without being curved or crooked.
original.ko: 모양이 비뚤어지거나 굽은 데가 없이 곧게.

proposed.en: A change in velocity over time; in everyday use, an increase in speed.
proposed.ko: 시간에 따른 속도의 변화. 일상적으로는 속력이 빨라지는 것.

reason: Acceleration is not speed itself.

original.en: An increase in speed, or the speed itself.
original.ko: 속도를 높임. 또는 그 속도.

reason: Local English Wiktionary chang noun attests an Asian harp, not Korean singing 창. This Korean transliteration needs independent English lexical attestation.

original.en: An act of singing pansori, Korean storytelling song, japga, folk song, etc., in tune, or such a song.
original.ko: 판소리나 잡가 등을 가락에 맞추어 부름. 또는 그런 노래.

proposed.en: To be exceptionally good at something.
proposed.ko: 어떤 일을 매우 뛰어나게 잘하다.

reason: The existing definition repeats excel and describes exceeding a limit instead.

original.en: To excel a certain range or level by far.
original.ko: 어떤 범위나 수준을 훨씬 넘어서다.

proposed.en: Having lost colour, brightness or strength.
proposed.ko: 색, 밝기나 힘이 바랜.

reason: Old and worn-out does not necessarily mean faded.

original.en: Old and worn-out.
original.ko: 오래되어 낡다.

reason: Definition of high-quality attractive ambience does not establish flavour; source sense requires realignment.

original.en: An air or impression of being high-quality and looking attractive.
original.ko: 매우 수준이 높고 보기 좋은 분위기나 인상.

proposed.en: Having existed or continued for a long time.
proposed.ko: 오랫동안 존재하거나 계속된.

reason: Longtime modifies a longstanding person or relationship, not simply a long day.

original.en: Being lengthy in a stretch of time such as a day or a period.
original.ko: 날, 시간, 세월 등이 매우 오래다.

proposed.en: A person whose wealth is at least one million units of a currency.
proposed.ko: 재산이 특정 통화로 최소 100만 단위에 이르는 백만장자.

reason: Millionaire has a numerical meaning, not merely very wealthy.

original.en: A person who is very wealthy.
original.ko: 재산이 아주 많은 사람. 또는 아주 큰 부자.

proposed.en: An exclamation used after a small mistake or accident.
proposed.ko: 작은 실수나 사고 뒤에 하는 감탄사.

reason: Oops generally acknowledges a mishap, not merely surprise.

original.en: An exclamation uttered when the speaker is startled.
original.ko: 깜짝 놀랐을 때 내는 소리.

proposed.en: A person who loves and supports their country.
proposed.ko: 자기 나라를 사랑하고 지지하는 애국자.

reason: Devote oneself to himself or herself is ungrammatical and distorts the intended loyalty.

original.en: A person who has the will to devote oneself to himself or herself to the nation and its people.
original.ko: 나라와 민족을 위해 자기 몸을 바쳐 일하려는 뜻을 가진 사람.

proposed.en: Maize kernels heated until they burst into light, puffy pieces.
proposed.ko: 옥수수 알을 가열해 터뜨린 가벼운 음식인 팝콘.

reason: Popcorn is popped, not necessarily fried or seasoned.

original.en: Seasoned and fried corn.
original.ko: 간을 하여 튀긴 옥수수.

proposed.en: To make something fresh or effective again, or extend its period of validity.
proposed.ko: 어떤 것을 새롭게 하거나 유효 기간을 연장하다.

reason: Renew is not simply an intransitive sudden change of atmosphere.

original.en: To become a new state after a sudden change in atmosphere, thought, etc., that lasted awhile.
original.ko: 한동안 계속되던 분위기나 생각 등이 갑자기 바뀌어 새로운 상태가 되다.

proposed.en: An uprising against authority or a government.
proposed.ko: 권위나 정부에 맞서 일으키는 반란.

reason: Not every major social event is a revolt.

original.en: Causing a major disruption in society.
original.ko: 사회적으로 크고 중요한 일을 일으킴.

proposed.en: To rise up against authority or a government.
proposed.ko: 권위나 정부에 맞서 봉기하다.

reason: Revolt requires resistance to authority, not just causing social disruption.

original.en: To cause a major disruption in society.
original.ko: 사회적으로 크고 중요한 일을 일으키다.

proposed.en: Alone or without companions.
proposed.ko: 혼자이거나 동반자가 없는.

reason: Solitary need not mean emotionally lonely.

original.en: Being lonesome because one is alone or has nobody to depend on.
original.ko: 혼자가 되거나 의지할 데가 없어서 쓸쓸하다.

proposed.en: The part of the leg between the hip and the knee.
proposed.ko: 엉덩이와 무릎 사이의 넓적다리.

reason: Thigh covers the whole upper leg, not just its inner flesh.

original.en: The thick-fleshy part of the inside the thigh.
original.ko: 허벅다리 안쪽의 살이 깊은 곳.

proposed.en: To grow, develop or succeed well.
proposed.ko: 잘 자라거나 발전하거나 번창하다.

reason: Thriving does not require prior weakness.

original.en: For something that is faint or weak to become strong.
original.ko: 희미하거나 약하던 것이 왕성해지다.

proposed.en: In North American English, a sleeveless garment worn over a shirt; a waistcoat.
proposed.ko: 북미 영어에서 셔츠 위에 입는 민소매 조끼인 waistcoat.

reason: This meaning of vest is North American; British vest usually means an undershirt.

original.en: A sleeveless garment worn over an upper garment.
original.ko: 윗옷에 덧입는, 소매가 없는 옷.

proposed.en: A written promise to repair or replace a faulty product within specified conditions.
proposed.ko: 정해진 조건에서 결함 있는 제품을 수리하거나 교환하겠다는 서면 보증.

reason: A warranty is not merely proof that a contract exists.

original.en: A document which certifies service or a product, or proves that a contract has been concluded.
original.ko: 제품이나 서비스가 틀림이 없음을 증명하거나 계약 등이 확실하게 이루어졌음을 증명하는 서류.

proposed.en: Having unlimited power.
proposed.ko: 무한한 힘을 지닌 전능한.

reason: Almighty is unlimited power, not simply being skilled at many things.

original.en: Great at everything without being poor at anything.
original.ko: 못하는 일이 없이 모든 일에 뛰어나다.

proposed.en: The settlement of a dispute by an independent person or body whose decision the parties agree to accept.
proposed.ko: 당사자들이 따르기로 한 독립적인 사람이나 기관의 판단으로 분쟁을 해결하는 중재.

reason: The source only describes reconciliation or mediation, omitting the deciding role.

original.en: The act of intervening and making the contending parties reconcile.
original.ko: 다투는 사람들 사이에 끼어들어 당사자들을 화해시킴.

proposed.en: The smallest unit of a chemical element that retains its identity.
proposed.ko: 화학 원소의 성질을 유지하는 가장 작은 단위인 원자.

reason: Atoms are not the smallest constituents of all matter; the element qualification matters.

original.en: The smallest unit that constitutes matter or indicates its quality.
original.ko: 물질을 이루며 그 물질의 성질을 나타내는 가장 작은 단위.

proposed.en: To lose blood from the body or a wound.
proposed.ko: 몸이나 상처에서 피가 나다.

reason: Stagnant water running out is not bleeding.

original.en: For a nosebleed or stagnant water to run down suddenly.
original.ko: 코피나 고인 물이 갑자기 쏟아지다.

proposed.en: To express strong disapproval of someone or something.
proposed.ko: 사람이나 일에 대해 강하게 비난하다.

reason: Condemn is stronger than any unfavourable comment; use British unfavourably if retaining original.

original.en: To speak unfavorably about someone's mistake or flaw.
original.ko: 다른 사람의 잘못이나 결점에 대해 나쁘게 말하다.

proposed.en: A direct conflict or encounter between opposing sides.
proposed.ko: 서로 대립하는 측이 직접 맞서는 충돌이나 대치.

reason: A mere difference of opinion is not necessarily a confrontation.

original.en: A thought, opinion, or stance being opposing or not consistent.
original.ko: 생각이나 의견, 입장이 서로 반대되거나 맞지 않음.

proposed.en: The lower floor or floors of a building.
proposed.ko: 건물의 아래층 부분.

reason: Use storey rather than story in British English for floors.

original.en: The story under a certain story.
original.ko: 어떤 층보다 아래에 있는 층.

proposed.en: A thick, oily substance used to lubricate machinery.
proposed.ko: 기계의 마찰을 줄이려고 바르는 걸쭉한 기름성 물질인 윤활 그리스.

reason: Grease is characteristically thick or semi-solid, not just any slippery liquid.

original.en: Slippery liquid, applied on a machine or tool, to make it work smoothly.
original.ko: 기계나 도구가 부드럽게 돌아가도록 바르는 미끈미끈한 액체.

proposed.en: To apply grease or fat to a surface.
proposed.ko: 표면에 그리스나 기름을 바르다.

reason: Greasing is not causing glue or arbitrary liquid to permeate.

original.en: To make liquid, glue paste, etc. permeate.
original.ko: 액체나 풀 등이 스며들게 하다.

proposed.en: A person who is romantically or sexually attracted to people of the same sex.
proposed.ko: 같은 성별의 사람에게 낭만적 또는 성적 끌림을 느끼는 사람.

reason: Same-sex love alone can include nonsexual affection; the orientation should be clear.

original.en: A person who loves another of the same sex.
